0022600210.text: The Warriors (7-3, riding a seven-game winning streak, 2nd in the Pacific and 4th in the West) host the Pelicans (4-5, coming off a loss, 5th in the Southwest and 11th in the West) in Golden State's 11th game of the 2026-27 season, with the Warriors at 5-1 at home. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), while Gui Santos is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and is a game-time decision; New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though their last meeting, on February 24, 2026 in New Orleans, ended in a 113-109 loss for Golden State.
